visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with long dark hair, wearing a grey beanie and a light purple fuzzy cardigan over a white camisole, sits on a brown leather sofa. A male guest with short black hair and round glasses, wearing an orange-yellow traditional-style jacket, sits next to her. They are both looking at the camera and gesturing with their hands in a brightly lit indoor room with a plain white wall. (2) The male guest begins explaining concepts with his hands while the female host listens attentively. Various cartoonish graphic overlays, such as a fishnet and text boxes, appear around the man's head as he speaks. (3) The female host reacts with high energy, touching her ears and laughing. A cartoon ear graphic and text appear near her face. The camera uses quick cuts between the two subjects to emphasize their reactions. (4) As the man describes eye and nose features, icons of eyes and a nose appear on screen. He uses wide hand gestures to describe 'large' features. (5) The camera captures a close-up of the woman laughing and pointing at the lens. (6) The man continues his lecture-style explanation about 'small eyes' and 'low nose bridges,' with corresponding text and graphic highlights appearing. (7) Both participants wave enthusiastically at the camera, signaling the end of the segment, with large brand/logo text overlays appearing on the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Definition 1 -> Reaction -> Definition 2 -> Reaction -> Summary/Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain and inform viewers about traditional physiognomy (face reading) in a social-media-friendly format. It specifically discusses facial features associated with 'Sea Kings' and 'Sea Queens' (slang for players or unfaithful partners), using a guest expert to provide a mix of humor and pseudo-expert advice.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density editing and variety-show style SFX to maintain engagement. The combination of physiognomy and relationship advice is a common high-performing social media niche.
